parameters.content:
## 🛡️ Stage 1 — Guard Input
Every **On Threat** value (Block / Redact / Warn / Continue), every **Sensitivity** (Balanced / Lenient / Strict), every **Topic Handling** (Trust+Restrict / Trust / Restrict / Advisory) and every **Detection Engine** (Local / Auto / Cloud).

All seven **Customer Replies**, **Ignored Words**, **Ignored Identifiers**, **Always Allow**, **System Prompt Context** and **Also Enforce On Sensitive Data** are set.

## 🔍 Stage 6 — Workflow Security Audit
Static analysis of a deliberately unsafe workflow export. Runs in-process and sends nothing.

## 🪪 Stage 7 — Agent Passport Lifecycle
All five operations in dependency order: **Enroll → Issue → Validate → Check Tool Call → Revoke**, with a custom **Access Policy JSON** on top of the Customer Support preset, and both a benign and a destructive tool call.
